definitions.explanation: A formal or trade term for leather and animal hides, especially in industrial and manufacturing contexts. The everyday word for leather is {革|かわ}.

examples.japanese: {皮革|ひかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧。
{皮革|ひかく}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The leather industry has a long history.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧な{皮革|ひかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This factory manufactures shoes using high-quality leather.

notes:
Composed of {皮|ひ} (skin) + {革|かく} (leather). A formal term used mainly in industry, business, and technical writing. In everyday speech, ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧ is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮革|ひかく}⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧: leather industry
- {皮革|ひかく}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: leather goods
- {皮革|ひかく}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: leather processing / tanning
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{皮革|ひかく}: genuine leather
- {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}: synthetic leather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧: leather — the everyday word; used for finished leather goods (⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧, a leather wallet)
- ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: skin; hide — the raw, untanned material; also means peel or shell
- レザー: leather — common loanword in fashion and product names
